purpose: Development and threshold-calibration split for the npc-command-kind research probe. Never used to report a held-out score and never used to fit a held-out threshold.

labelProvenance.note: Every label is AUTHORED in this contract against the authored option descriptions in tasks/npc_command_kind.ts. No model judged any label. 'required-abstain' cases carry expected 'none' - no command is warranted - and a command fired on one is the unsafe acceptance the safety gate counts. 'excluded' cases are genuinely ungradable (two defensible readings) and are removed from every denominator rather than being scored as negatives or rewarded as coverage.
sources: contract-authored player messages written for this corpus

SHIPPED PRODUCT TEXT: cases in category 'authored-in-product' are the exact prefillText strings the game sends to an NPC as a player message, taken verbatim from apps/frontend/client/src/lib/data/initial_suggestion_presets.ts. They were authored for this product and are split across dev/heldout so no string appears in both.
corrections: giveItem direction corrected. The original pilot described it as the player handing an item to the NPC; NpcDialogueGiveItemCommandSchema grants the item to the PLAYER and requires the NPC to possess it. Cases '*-giveitem-*' and '*-giveitem-reverse-*' pin both directions.
'none' added as a real literal. The original schema had no ordinary no-command outcome, while NpcDialogueAiEnvelopeSchema types `command` as optional.
limitations: No external multi-author consented player-transcript corpus was available. Labels are one contract author's; the shipped product strings add real distribution but not independent authorship. Treat a pass on this corpus as necessary, not sufficient.
The corpus grades a command KIND only. Production commands carry itemId/quantity/questId/skill/difficultyClass and are gated by world preconditions, none of which this probe exercises.
